## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; confirmation: weak cross-sector breadth plus narrow leadership concentrated in Technology (Top 5 all Tech), signaling mixed internals and the need to reduce risk gradually.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Technology leads: AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +8.44% | 1M: +17.01%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +4.70% | 1M: +12.60%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples: MNST (1W: +11.89% | 1M: +13.26%) ABOVE TREND, CVS (1W: +10.31% | 1M: +15.86%) ABOVE TREND. Materials/Disc show pockets of strength but less concentrated leadership.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Energy weak: XOM (1W: -5.36% | 1M: -6.75%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -4.73% | 1M: -4.59%) BELOW TREND, COP (1W: -7.57% | 1M: -7.78%) BELOW TREND. Financials under pressure: JPM (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -2.65%) BELOW TREND, PYPL (1W: -10.05% | 1M: -1.33%) BELOW TREND. Communication services weak: CMCSA (1W: -6.58% | 1M: -10.28%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND; INTC (1W: +25.40% | 1M: +102.40%) ABOVE TREND; QCOM (1W: +23.77% | 1M: +71.50%) ABOVE TREND; PANW (1W: +14.80% | 1M: +24.49%) ABOVE TREND; LRCX (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +13.64%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: SLB (1W: -6.41% | 1M: +1.39%) TREND EXHAUSTION; EOG (1W: -6.42% | 1M: -4.06%) BELOW TREND; CMCSA (1W: -6.58% | 1M: -10.28%) BELOW TREND; COP (1W: -7.57% | 1M: -7.78%) BELOW TREND; SHOP (1W: -13.52% | 1M: -1.75%) BELOW TREND — Weakness concentrated in Energy/Comm.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W moves: AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +25.40% | 1M: +102.40%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +23.77% | 1M: +71.50%) ABOVE TREND; watch divergence between blistering Tech momentum and weak Financials — tactical, not broad market confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech is the engine but concentrated: NVDA (1W: +8.44% | 1M: +17.01%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +4.70% | 1M: +12.60%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +11.27%) ABOVE TREND; sector 1W: +6.30% | 1M: +21.99% (24 stocks) — above-trend gains driven by semiconductors and select software.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are lagging and fractured: JPM (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -2.65%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -2.82% | 1M: +3.41%) TREND EXHAUSTION, PYPL (1W: -10.05% | 1M: -1.33%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W: -2.18% | 1M: -0.64% — watch for further downside or consolidation.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare mixed-to-weak: UNH (1W: +3.04% | 1M: +23.81%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: -2.58% | 1M: -8.28%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -1.54% | 1M: -0.71%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W: -1.00% | 1M: -4.63% — select winners amid defensives fading.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective exposure to quality Tech names showing clear ABOVE TREND signals (AMD, NVDA, AAPL) and best-in-class Healthcare (UNH); reduce exposure to weak Energy and lagging Financials (XOM, CVX, JPM) while monitoring narrow leadership for signs of broader participation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +25.40% | 1M: +102.40%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +3.04% | 1M: +23.81%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XOM (1W: -5.36% | 1M: -6.75%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -2.65%) BELOW TREND, CMCSA (1W: -6.58% | 1M: -10.28%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +6.30% | 1M: +21.99%) showing momentum but narrow. BEARISH: Energy (1W: -5.04% | 1M: -1.38%) and Financials (1W: -2.18% | 1M: -0.64%) for continued pressure.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: +8.44% | 1M: +17.01%) ABOVE TREND — hold recent breakout to confirm continuation; AAPL (1W: +4.70% | 1M: +12.60%) ABOVE TREND — sustain 1M trend to keep leadership status; JPM (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -2.65%) BELOW TREND — reclaiming 1M performance needed to reduce downside risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
UNH (+75): UnitedHealth earnings beat/guidance lift; price confirming (UNH (1W: +3.04% | 1M: +23.81%) ABOVE TREND). SLB (+80): upbeat automation/AI outlook but price diverging (SLB (1W: -6.41% | 1M: +1.39%) TREND EXHAUSTION) — news bullish, price weakening. EOG (+60): upward estimate revisions but price below trend (EOG (1W: -6.42% | 1M: -4.06%) BELOW TREND) — sentiment vs price divergence.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
JPM (-55): lawsuit/governance headlines align with price (JPM (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -2.65%) BELOW TREND) — confirming risk. ORCL (-45): layoffs/AI cost concerns but price strong (ORCL (1W: +14.04% | 1M: +42.14%) ABOVE TREND) — negative sentiment with price-strength divergence. ASML (-45): CEO comments generate caution while stock remains strong (ASML (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND) — watch for follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, Growth/Momentum style driven by narrow Tech leadership. AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +8.44% | 1M: +17.01%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +4.70% | 1M: +12.60%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow leadership and mixed news flow (ORCL/ASML negative sentiment vs rising prices) — monitor for trend break.
